senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be wide, roomy; to spread.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:4:3">Y. Snh. I, 19ᶜ</cite> top <he>משם התורה יוצאה ורווַֹחַת וכ׳</he> from there (the hall of the Sanhedrin) the law went forth and spread (with authority) for all Israel; Tosef. ib. VII, 1; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:9">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 9</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6:3">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ראה … רווחת בישראל</he> see how this decision will spread (what its effect will be) in Israel; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>רָווּחַ</he>; pl. <he>רְווּחִים</he>.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:5">Ab. V, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>משתחוים</he>, <he>ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00705"><he>צָפַף</he></cite>; [Mish. ed. <he>רְוָחִים</he>, pl. of <cite ref="T00343"><he>רָוָח</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be placed wide apart.—Part. מְרוּוָּח; f. מְרוּוַּחַת; pl. מְרוּוָּחִים, מְרוּוָּחִין; מְרוּוָּחוֹת (or מְרֻיָּו׳). Y. Shebi. II, end, 34ᵇ במר׳ when the trees are planted wide apart, opp. רצופין; Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ top; a. e.

units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:23">Koh. R. to VII, 23</cite> <he>מקום מר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00328"><he>רֶוַוח</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 6</cite> <he>לשונות מר׳</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:5">Kel. XVIII, 5</cite> wide and flat straps (comfortable to lie on), v. <cite ref="L00232"><he>לוּחַ</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:12">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>משא … מַרְוִיחִין</he> commerce is prosperous, and the dealers make profit; <he>אף … מרויחין</he> even the lepers feel relieved; Yalk. ib. 20.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:1">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>החולה … ומַרְוִיחַ</he> the sick man saw him (Abraham) and felt better.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 843:15">Yalk. Ps. 843</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00328"><he>רֶוַוח</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:1">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>מרויחין לו</he> they (the visitors) bring him some relief; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 41:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLI</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be relieved, be in comfortable circumstances. Lev. R. l. c. לכשאתה מִתְרַוּוֵחַ וכ׳ when thou art in better circumstances, thou wilt repay me.—[Ib., a. e. נתרווח העולם, read: נִתְרַוֶּוה, v. רָוָה.]
